references.label: Boat Dock shots
references.description: The lit Boat Dock entrances can spot difficult Species groups during Tri-Ball qualification.

references.label: Raptor Pit
references.description: The Raptor Pit is the right-side sinkhole used to start the first Tri-Ball.

references.context: During Tri-Ball, shoot the ramp for the Jackpot.
references.label: Tri-Ball Jackpot ramp
references.description: The main ramp collects the regular Tri-Ball Jackpot and later Super Jackpot.

references.label: Helicopter Pad loop
references.description: The Helicopter Pad entrance switches collect the Double Jackpot and later Super Jackpot.

references.label: T-Rex feed
references.description: The T-Rex mechanism is the center-right feed used before the twin Super Jackpots.

references.context: Shoot the lit left-center scoop for the current Computer Screen.
references.label: Control Room scoop
references.description: The left-center Control Room collects the current Computer Screen.

references.label: Power Shed target
references.description: The Power Shed relights Control Room and can start System Failure.
